outcome: Prevent ordinary pull requests from creating macOS Testing or Install Matrix jobs while preserving explicit release-candidate coverage and blocking publication unless both compatibility gates are green for the exact release SHA.
scope: Change macos-testing.yml and install-matrix.yml triggers and SHA evidence; add only the approved fail-closed compatibility-check step and checks:read permission to semantic-release.yml; add one deterministic policy test and package script; update the Actions runbook and reproducible evidence. No remote mutation, release, push, PR, protected-path edit, branch-protection edit, or other release-flow edit.
inputs: Current workflow YAML and branch-protection observations recorded in the story
Baseline SHA-256 hashes for seven byte-for-byte invariant workflows and the pre-gate semantic-release.yml
outputs: Manual-only macOS Testing workflow with SHA-bound evidence
Install Matrix triggered only by workflow_dispatch or pull_request:labeled with release-label job guards and SHA-bound evidence
Semantic Release compatibility gate that queries check-runs for the exact release SHA and fails closed
Deterministic policy fitness test and operational documentation
Validation and cost evidence in this session record
acceptance: Ordinary opened, synchronized, and reopened pull requests create no runs or jobs for the two expensive workflows
Explicit dispatch and release-label events retain three macOS validations, 24 install combinations, three clean installs, and three upgrades
Required candidate_sha inputs, dispatch-ref equality, and checked-out HEAD equality bind evidence to the tested commit
Seven workflows remain byte-for-byte invariant; semantic-release.yml differs only by checks:read and the approved compatibility gate; required Article VII, VIII, XI job names remain
Release fails on API error, missing, pending, unsuccessful, or other-SHA Install Matrix/macOS gate evidence
YAML parsing, immutable action pins, focused policy tests, lint, typecheck, and proportional regression tests pass

asrs: Zero automatic macOS or Install Matrix jobs for ordinary pull-request activity
All release-candidate evidence is attributable to the exact tested SHA
Invariant workflow content is byte-for-byte protected
architecture.decision: Keep the existing workflow boundaries. Restrict triggers, require exact candidate SHAs, remove the always-created Install Matrix gate job, enforce release-label eligibility directly on every retained matrix/summary job, and place the final compatibility check immediately after checkout in the canonical Semantic Release workflow.
rejected_options: Consolidating Article VII, VIII, or XI jobs because their names are required branch-protection contexts
Editing CodeQL filters because the validated story makes codeql.yml byte-for-byte invariant
Disabling or deleting cosmetic workflow files because remote state changes are outside authority
Putting the publication gate in Release Preparation because it would check the pre-release PR creation commit rather than the exact commit being published
risks: GitHub pull_request:labeled cannot filter the label value at trigger level; non-release labels can create a workflow run, but every job is guarded and remains skipped
Manual dispatch must select a ref resolving to the required candidate_sha; mismatches fail before expensive runners start
Check-run names are an API contract: renaming either compatibility gate requires a coordinated fitness-test and release-gate change
Local policy tests cannot prove remote branch-protection or check-runs API conclusions until a PR and dispatches exist
